subject: Pricing & committed-use options — recap and next steps
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@novaflow.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing & committed-use options — recap and next steps

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the sync today — quick recap and a couple of asks so we can prepare a committed-use proposal that maps to your ramp. Highlights from the call: 

- Use case: API-first semantic search + in-product assistant for developers (prod in Q4).
- Current usage: prototype traffic (~30M tokens / month) across indexing + chat.
- Expected ramp: target ~300M tokens/month within 6–9 months if pilot metrics hold.
- Key constraints: early budget (~$6–10k/mo) but willing to consider a committed contract if we can get predictable unit economics and ramp credits.

Action items I promised: 
1) Ask you to confirm more precise monthly token ranges (best estimate for months 1, 3, 6).
2) Confirm target price band you’re aiming for (e.g. target $/1M tokens).
3) Confirm whether Novaflow qualifies for our startup program (are you VC-backed < $10M ARR / Series A or earlier?).
4) If procurement/legal want to be looped in early, please add them — we can route a sample term sheet.

To make the discussion concrete, can you reply with the following by end of week?
- Estimated tokens/mo today, in 3 months, in 6 months (ranges are fine).
- Rough monthly budget we can allocate to API spend at those stages (range ok).
- Target $/1M tokens you would consider acceptable for committed pricing.

I attached our latest pricing sheet (redwood-pricing-sheet-v2.pdf) and will draft 2 committed-use examples once I have your numbers (3/12/24-month tiers + multi-year incentives / ramp credits).

If it helps, I can block 30 minutes next Tue/Wed for a quick walk-through with our pricing lead (Marissa) and a sample financial model.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.inference | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood-pricing-sheet-v2.pdf

From: Samantha Lee <samantha@novaflow.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
Cc: Novaflow Procurement <procurement@novaflow.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing & committed-use options — recap and next steps

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for the clear recap — appreciate the options. Quick answers below so you can draft examples: 

- Tokens/month: Today (prod/prototype): ~30M/month.
- 3 months: expecting ~90–120M/month (after pilot launch).
- 6 months: planning for 250–350M/month if pilot KPIs hit.

Budget: initial budget for pilot is ~$6k–10k/mo (covers first 2–3 months). If we see engagement, we can commit to a predictable spend of ~$5k/mo to start in exchange for committed discounts and ramp credits while we scale.

Target $/1M tokens: Our finance lead suggested target of approximately $700–$900 per 1M tokens at scale; below $750 would be ideal but we realize enterprise discounts apply as volume grows.

Startup program: We are seed+ (raised $2.5M seed, not yet Series A) and meet the VC-backed criteria. Would like to understand what credits/discounts are available and the process to enroll.

Procurement (procurement@novaflow.ai) is looped in for contracting cadence — they prefer a 30-day review turnaround with a standard SOC2 + shared security addendum.

Please send 2 sample commitment plans: (A) a conservative 12-month committed-use that starts at 60% of projected 6-month volume and (B) a aggressive 24-month multi-year plan with ramp credits for months 1–3. Also include startup credit details and any timing constraints.

Best,
Samantha 
Head of Product | Novaflow
samantha@novaflow.ai

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@novaflow.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, Novaflow Procurement <procurement@novaflow.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing & committed-use options — recap and next steps

Thanks Samantha — this is great and very actionable. Per your asks, I sketched two commitment examples and the startup option below (sending the formal quote and term sheet as a follow-up attachment). High level: we can get you into the target $/1M range you mentioned with either a startup package + short committed ramp, or a 12–24 month committed-use deal depending on how you want to trade flexibility vs. unit economics.

Summary (examples):

List unit price (reference): $1,200 / 1M tokens (this is our public list for the model profile you tested).

A) Startup program (Novaflow qualifies)
- One-time credits: $25,000 platform credit applied over first 6 months.
- Additional 30% usage discount for first 6 months (applies after credits).
- No long-term commitment required.
- Expected effective price in pilot months: with credits + 30% off, effective price can be near $700–$850 /1M depending on mix of embedding vs. generation tokens.

B) 12-month committed-use (conservative ramp)
- Commitment: 180M tokens/mo (60% of your 6-month projection) billed monthly with 12-month term.
- Discount: 20% off list for committed baseline.
- Ramp credits: first 2 months 50% billable on overage up to 50% above committed baseline.
- Effective price at baseline: $960 / 1M; at 2x baseline on discounted tiers, blended effective price can drop toward ~$700–$800 /1M.

C) 24-month / multi-year incentive (aggressive plan)
- Commitment: flexible ramp schedule up to 350M tokens/mo; 24-month term.
- Discount: 30% off list for committed baseline; additional multi-year incentive credit (one-time) equal to 5% of first-year committed spend applied as consumption credit.
- Price cap guarantee: locked price for 24 months.
- Effective price at baseline: $840 / 1M; with multi-year incentives and expected volume growth, blended price can approach your $700 target as you scale.

Sample math (illustrative):
- At 300M tokens/mo list cost = 300 * $1,200 = $360,000/mo.
- With 30% committed discount = $840 /1M -> $252,000/mo.
- With startup credits for early months the effective monthly cash outlay is lower during ramp.

Next steps I suggest: 
1) I’ll send an updated formal quote that includes exact billing language and sample invoice schedule (will attach redwood-commitment-sample-term.docx).
2) If you want finance/legal alignment, let’s do a 30-min call early next week (Mon/Tue) — I can include Marissa (pricing lead) and our legal ops rep to speed review.
3) Please confirm which path you prefer (Startup + short commit vs 12mo vs 24mo) and the exact committed baseline number you’d like modeled.

If procurement has standard SLA exceptions, forward them and we’ll flag during legal review. I’ll also open a HubSpot quote (DEAL-2026-1987) and share the DocuSign link when the quote is ready.

Thanks — talk soon.

Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.inference | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-pricing-sheet-v2.pdf, redwood-commitment-sample-term.docx
